Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema
Schema building: describe tables with a Blueprint and run them through a Schema.

The SQL for each database comes from a SchemaGrammar, which lives in that database's module, for example diwan-database-sqlite. The core never depends on a grammar module; the application passes the grammar in.
